      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {

      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "Le cas resp., où on part",
      "note": "« respé » is a printed typo for « resp. »; the TeX keeps it."
    },
    {
      "page": 376,
      "where": "Paragraph beginning « Le cas respé »",
      "scan": "un préfaisceau $P$ sur $X$",

      "kind": "word",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "préfaisceau $P$ sut $X$",
        "new": "préfaisceau $P$ sur $X$"
      },
      "note": "The print reads « sur »."
    },
    {
      "page": 376,
      "where": "Functorial isomorphism for a presheaf",
      "scan": "$\\varphi^{\\ast}a(P) \\simeq a\\varphi^{\\bigdot}(P)$",
      "tex": "$\\varphi^{\\ast}a(P) \\simeq a\\varphi^{\\ast}(P)$",
      "kind": "symbol",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "\\varphi^{\\ast} (P)",
        "new": "\\varphi^{\\bigdot} (P)"

      "note": "The right-hand occurrence of phi has a superscript dot, not an asterisk."
    },
    {
      "page": 376,
      "where": "Proof of the monomorphism assertion, after replacing X by X′",
      "scan": "utilisant la transitivité des foncteurs fibres",
      "tex": "utilisant le transitivité des foncteurs fibres",
      "kind": "word",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "utilisant le transitivité",
        "new": "utilisant la transitivité"
      },
      "note": "The print reads « la »."
    },
    {
      "page": 376,
      "where": "Last paragraph, after « dont l'image contient x »",
      "scan": "tel $\\varphi$ et $\\psi$ aient même image inverse",
      "tex": "tel\n$\\varphi$ et $\\psi$ aient même image inverse",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "tel que $\\varphi$ et $\\psi$ aient même image inverse",
      "note": "The print omits « que » after « tel »; the TeX keeps the omission."
    },
    {
      "page": 377,
      "where": "First paragraph, existence of X′_x",
      "scan": "pour tout $x \\in X$, existe $X'_x$",
      "tex": "pour tout $x \\in X$, \\sisi{}{il} existe $X'_x$",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "pour tout $x \\in X$, il existe $X'_x$",
      "note": "The print omits « il ». The edition supplies it through \\sisi, whose first argument correctly records the omission."
    },
    {
      "page": 377,
      "where": "First paragraph, overlaps on which the sections coincide",
      "scan": "$X'_x \\times_X X'_y$ $(x,y \\in X)$",
      "tex": "$\\fprod{X'_x}{X'_x}{X}$ $(x, y \\in X)$",
      "kind": "formula",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "\\fprod{X'_x}{X'_x}{X}",
        "new": "\\fprod{X'_x}{X'_y}{X}"
      },
      "note": "The second factor is indexed by y in the print."
    },
    {
      "page": 377,
      "where": "Scholie 3.10, first sentence",
      "scan": "jouit des mêmes propriétés essentielles",
      "tex": "jouit des même propriétés essentielles",
      "kind": "word",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "jouit des même propriétés",
        "new": "jouit des mêmes propriétés"
      },
      "note": "The print has the plural « mêmes »."
    },
    {
      "page": 377,
      "where": "Scholie 3.10, last sentence",
      "scan": "pour cette raison nous dispenserons généralement d'y référer explicitement",
      "tex": "pour cette raison nous \\sisi{}{nous} dispenserons généralement d'y référer explicitement",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "pour cette raison nous nous dispenserons généralement d'y référer explicitement",
      "note": "The print omits the reflexive « nous ». The edition corrects this through \\sisi."
    },
    {
      "page": 377,
      "where": "3.11, introduction of the morphism i_x",
      "scan": "pour le morphisme structurel habituel",
      "tex": "pour le morphisme structural habituel",
      "kind": "word",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "morphisme structural habituel",
        "new": "morphisme structurel habituel"
      },
      "note": "The printed adjective is « structurel », not « structural »."
    },
    {
      "page": 378,
      "where": "Paragraph beginning « Si x̄ », reference defining the functor j",
      "scan": "du foncteur $j$ de 1.1",
      "tex": "du foncteur $j$ de \\sisi{\\hyperref[VIII.thm1.1]{1.1}}{\\hyperref[VIII.prop2.1]{2.1}}",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "du foncteur $j$ de \\hyperref[VIII.prop2.1]{2.1}",
      "note": "The printed reference 1.1 should be 2.1. The edition records the printed number correctly and corrects it through \\sisi."
    },
    {
      "page": 378,
      "where": "End of the paragraph discussing the two meanings of F_x",
      "scan": "mais en vertu de 1.1 c'est là une contradiction inessentielle",
      "tex": "mais en vertu de \\sisi{\\hyperref[VIII.thm1.1]{1.1}}{\\hyperref[VIII.prop2.1]{2.1}} c'est là une contradiction inessentielle",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "mais en vertu de \\hyperref[VIII.prop2.1]{2.1} c'est là une contradiction inessentielle",
      "note": "The printed reference 1.1 should again be 2.1; the edition corrects it through \\sisi."
    },
    {
      "page": 378,
      "where": "3.12, opening sentence",
      "scan": "$\\bar{x} = \\Spec k(x)$",
      "tex": "$\\bar{x} = \\Spec k(x)$",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "$\\bar{x} = \\Spec \\bar{k(x)}$",
      "note": "The algebraic-closure bar over k(x) is missing in the print. The preceding paragraph and the Galois group immediately below make the intended field clear. The TeX keeps the omission."
    },
    {
      "page": 378,
      "where": "3.12, parenthetical reference after the displayed functor",
      "scan": "grâce à 1.1",
      "tex": "grâce à \\sisi{\\hyperref[VIII.thm1.1]{1.1}}{\\hyperref[VIII.prop2.1]{2.1}}",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "grâce à \\hyperref[VIII.prop2.1]{2.1}",
      "note": "The printed reference 1.1 should be 2.1; the edition corrects it through \\sisi."
    },
    {
      "page": 379,
      "where": "Remarque 3.13(a), example of a Jacobson scheme",
      "scan": "$\\Spec(\\mathbf{Z})$",
      "tex": "$\\Spec(𝒵)$",
      "kind": "font",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "\\Spec(𝒵)",
        "new": "\\Spec(\\mathbf{Z})"
      },
      "note": "The print has the underlined Z denoting the integers, not a script capital Z. Bold Z uses the edition's permitted convention for this sign."

    {
      "page": 380,
      "where": "Universal property of the henselization",

      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "dans des anneaux locaux henséliens",
      "note": "The universal property concerns henselian local rings, not noetherian local rings. The edition corrects the printed « noethériens » through \\sisi."
    }
